_comment: No chrome.debugger tools (docs/TOOL_TRIAGE_DRAFT.md §3b) for browsers without Advanced control: 11 raw FastLink tools + ask_caller/report_done = 13. Select with --toolset no-cdp.

describe.fast_snapshot: Read the current page: interactive elements (text, label, live value, coords) plus readable content blocks; visible cross-origin frames are read too, under `frames` (item ids "f<frameId>:<i>"). Pass overlay:true when an open menu's options are missing, full:true to lift the ~70-item cap, screenshot:true only to visually confirm.
describe.fast_text: Return the page's innerText (or one element's via selector; html:true for outerHTML). Use for data extraction such as tables and lists; maxLen caps the size.
describe.fast_click: Click the element whose text/label/placeholder matches `text` (narrow with role, tag, or index = the N-th text match, 0-based), or the exact snapshot item `id` ("42", or "f7:42" inside a frame); targets in a visible cross-origin frame are found too (`frame:"<part of the frame URL>"` picks the frame). Returns a fresh snapshot, so do not call fast_snapshot right after.
describe.fast_fill: Set fields by label/placeholder/name: one with {match, value} or a whole form with fields:{label: value | {value, index, section}} (native selects included) — a form with 2+ inputs is one call; fields in a visible cross-origin frame are found too (`frame` picks one). Returns verified + live value per field and a fresh snapshot.
describe.fast_select_option: Choose `option` in the dropdown labelled `field` (native, react-select, Angular, ARIA; in a visible cross-origin frame too, `frame` picks one). Use selections:{field:option} to set several in one call.
describe.fast_key_press: Press `key` (Enter, Escape, Tab, ArrowDown...) on the focused element.
describe.fast_scroll: Scroll the page, the nearest scroll container, or with `frame:"<part of the frame URL>"` inside that frame: to:"top"|"bottom"|"50%" or pixels (negative = up), with neither one screenful down. Returns moved, atEnd and a fresh snapshot.
describe.fast_wait: Wait until `text` appears (case-insensitive substring — use two or more words; visible cross-origin frames are searched too), or `selector` matches a visible element, or with networkIdle:true (alone) until requests settle; with text + networkIdle the text is the signal and the result reports networkIdle/pending instead of timing out. Use after an action that triggers async loading; returns the matched element and a snapshot, emptyContainer:true when only a stale/empty container matched (the view has not rendered), or the visible headings on timeout.
describe.fast_tab: Open `url` in a new tab, focus it and wait for it to load (waitMs, default 10s). Returns the page's snapshot preview, frame items included, so act on it directly.
describe.fast_nav: Go to `url` in the current tab and wait for the load (waitMs, default 10s). Returns the page's snapshot preview, frame items included, so act on it directly.
describe.fast_batch: Run several steps in one round-trip (actions:[{name,args}]) — every step runs even if one misses, and the result leads with a summary line ("5/6 steps ok; step 3 (fast_fill \"Ocean\") missed: …") plus per-step verified state or the miss with candidates; only the last step returns a snapshot. Use it whenever the next steps are already known — a whole form (fast_fill {fields}, fast_select_option, fast_key_press, fast_click) is ONE batch; a conditional step {ifFound:"text or css selector", then:[…], else:[…]} branches inside the batch without a model turn.
